description: This file contains functions and definitions related to list objects filtering options, including parsing filter options, managing filter specifications, and handling partial clone configurations within a Git-related project.

methods.name: const char * list_object_filter_config_name(enum list_objects_filter_choice c)
methods.description: Returns the string name associated with a specific list object filter choice.

methods.name: int gently_parse_list_objects_filter(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter_options,const char * arg,struct strbuf * errbuf)
methods.description: Parses the list objects filter option string and populates the filter options structure accordingly.

methods.name: int parse_combine_filter(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter_options,const char * arg,struct strbuf * errbuf)
methods.description: Parses combined filter specifications separated by '+', establishing a composite filter.

methods.name: int parse_combine_subfilter(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter_options,struct strbuf * subspec,struct strbuf * errbuf)
methods.description: Parses individual sub-filter specifications within a combined filter.

methods.name: int allow_unencoded(char ch)
methods.description: Checks if a character is allowed without URL encoding in filter specs.

methods.name: void filter_spec_append_urlencode(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter,const char * raw)
methods.description: Appends raw filter spec data to the filter's specification string, URL-encoded.

methods.name: void transform_to_combine_type(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter_options)
methods.description: Converts an existing filter option into a combined filter type for further composition.

methods.name: void list_objects_filter_die_if_populated(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter_options)
methods.description: Terminates if the filter options structure is already populated to prevent multiple definitions.

methods.name: void parse_list_objects_filter(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter_options,const char * arg)
methods.description: Main function to parse filter options string and populate the options structure.

methods.name: int opt_parse_list_objects_filter(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Option parser callback for command-line or config parsing to set filter options.

methods.name: const char * list_objects_filter_spec(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter)
methods.description: Returns the filter specification string for a given filter options.

methods.name: const char * expand_list_objects_filter_spec(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter)
methods.description: Expands the filter specification string if needed, e.g., in case of limits.

methods.name: void list_objects_filter_release(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter_options)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a filter options structure.

methods.name: void partial_clone_register(const char * remote,struct list_objects_filter_options * filter_options)
methods.description: Registers a remote for partial clone operations with associated filter options.

methods.name: void partial_clone_get_default_filter_spec(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter_options,const char * remote)
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the default filter specification for a remote partial clone.

methods.name: void list_objects_filter_copy(struct list_objects_filter_options * dest,const struct list_objects_filter_options * src)
methods.description: Deep copies filter options structure from source to destination.

methods.name: void list_objects_filter_init(struct list_objects_filter_options * filter_options)
methods.description: Initializes a filter options structure to default state.
